_about: Expected answers for the exoplanet-host agent. Taken from the NASA Exoplanet Archive (pscomppars) and Sesame on 2026-10-19; re-check when the archive adds planets. 'hosts' maps each expected archive hostname to its number of confirmed planets.

cases.tests: high proper motion: the host is 16 arcsec from its J2000 position, so a small cone misses it
very high proper motion: 60 arcsec offset, a 1 arcmin cone only just finds it; archive hostname is 'Proxima Cen'
alias: the archive lists this system under hostname 'KOI-351', so get_planets('Kepler-90') fails
simple case: one host, one planet
simple case; Sesame's main ID has extra spaces ('*  51 Peg')
negative control: no confirmed hosts within 2 arcmin; the agent must say so, not invent any
unresolvable name: the agent must report it, not guess coordinates
